evidence.experimental_conditions: 80 µM GST concentration, 60 min incubation, in vitro with purified human GSTs and GSH

evidence.support_text: In male Fischer 344 rats given a single intraperitoneal dose of 250 mg/kg cinnamaldehyde in trioctanoin and pretreated with 35S-CySH, analysis of urine by HPLC and GC-MS revealed two mercapturic acid metabolites, N-acetyl-S-(1-phenyl-3-hydroxypropyl)cysteine and N-acetyl-S-(1-phenyl-3-carboxypropyl)cysteine, in an average ratio of 3:1, indicating in vivo covalent GSH conjugation.
